subject: ela
intro: Read each fact text and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

Bees make honey.

What do bees make?
A) Milk
B) Honey
C) Bread

Read.

Fish live in water.

Where do fish live?
A) In water
B) In trees
C) In caves

steps: 'Fish live in water.' Key is A.

items.prompt:
